evidence.title: GitHub - pmndrs/zustand: 🐻 Bear necessities for state management in React · GitHub

name: Zustand
summary: Small, fast state management for React built on simplified flux principles, as a hook you can use anywhere.
description: State management for React in a small package: create a store hook with create(), use it anywhere without context providers, and components re-render when selected state changes. Recipes cover selecting multiple slices with useShallow, async actions, transient updates, persist, immer and redux-devtools middleware, and the core can also be used without React. Unopinionated about structure, with a separate TypeScript usage guide.
contains: store is a hook; no context providers needed
middleware: persist, immer, devtools and subscribeWithSelector
TypeScript usage guide and beginner/advanced guides
